newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares weaken in uncertain, nervy market.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares weaken in uncertain, nervy market.

text.p: Swedish shares slipped on Friday morning in mixed trade with some nerves creeping into the market after recent highs in Stockholm and New York.
The Stockholm general index fell 0.27 percent to 3,154.83 in light, summer turnover of 764 million crowns.
"The bourse is a bit nervous now and uncertain how large a recoil there could be," said one broker. He said players were waiting to see how Wall Street opened later today.
Market heavyweight Ericsson fell 3.5 to 334.5 crowns, losing some of its recent strong gains that followed a positive report by Salomon Brothers.
Drugs major Astra rose two to 153 crowns after slumping six percent on Thursday when it announced lower than expected Losec sales in the U.S. in the first half of 1997.
Aerial maker Allgon was posting gains, rising 6.5 to 129.5 crowns, after being recommended as a buy by brokerage Matteus. The stock had fallen on Thursday after it posted its six month earnings.
Industrial powder company Hoganas was one of the morning's winners, climbing 8.5 to 263.5 crowns after the managing director forecast a strong second half of 1997.
